card.name: Metformin lactic acidosis warning wording
card.fires_on: The word "by" after "were accompanied" and the comma after "hypothermia", both in the metformin lactic acidosis boxed warning.

modes.label: accompanied by
modes.description: The word "by" right after "accompanied" in the sentence about subtle onset of lactic acidosis, before nonspecific symptoms.
modes.example: These cases had a subtle onset and were accompanied<< by>> nonspecific symptoms such as malaise,

modes.label: comma after hypothermia
modes.description: The comma after "hypothermia" in the list of outcomes of metformin-associated lactic acidosis.
modes.example: WARNING: LACTIC ACIDOSIS Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia<<,>> hypotension, and resistant brady

card.plain: It marks fixed spots in the standard metformin lactic acidosis warning text, just before the symptom list continues.
